hypothesised_pattern: Target class is class_2 when x4^2 - 0.25 exceeds about 1.85*|x2*x5|, and otherwise follows the sign of x2*x5, with positive giving class_1 and negative giving class_0.
functional_form_guess: predict class_2 if x4^2 - 0.25 > 1.85*|x2*x5|, else class_1 if x2*x5 > 0, else class_0
rationale: All ten examples fit the rule. Idx 7 lies close to the boundary, with x4^2 - 0.25 of about 0.92 against 1.85*|x2*x5| of about 0.87, and it is class 2. Idx 0 and 5 have x4^2 of about 0.45 to 0.50 with negative x2*x5 and are class 0, so the base model's class 1 prediction there looks like a failure to use the sign of the product.
